abilities.description: The boss summons a necrotic orb that follows the party around dealing moderate magical damage over time as indicated by a red circle.

abilities.description: The boss summons Restless Souls from the altars around the arena to attack the party. They should be killed quickly to simplify the fight.

related_quests: Deception in the Dark: Prevent an underground invasion of Wayrest.
Pledge: Wayrest Sewers I: Explore Wayrest Sewers I and return Undaunted.
summary: Investigator Garron is a Breton necromancer and a former officer of the Lion Guard who turned on his partners while they were looking for bandits located inside the Wayrest Sewers I. He has a chance to drop the unique item Garron's Cold Betrayal. In Wayrest Sewers II, he comes back as a Lich named Garron the Returned.
